tenses_found: reported speech (asked if I could go)
grammatical_complexity.notes: Dominated by simple past and present simple, especially in dialogue. Complex structures appear occasionally (passive gerund, past perfect passive, modal perfect, so...that) but are not frequent enough to constitute a noticeable minority of sentences.

references_found: Day of the Dead (Día de los Muertos)
cultural_reference_load.notes: The entire cultural setting is Mexican/Latin American. A Latin American learner would recognize all cultural references including Day of the Dead, Mexican foods, and the Virgen de Guadalupe. No unfamiliar North American customs.

sentence_structure.notes: Short to moderate sentences throughout. Dialogue lines are very short (often 2-6 words). Narrative sentences are moderate with some conjunctions. No long multi-clause sentences.

items.context: Gabby didn't complain once the entire time
items.reason: Spanish speaker might initially think 'eleven' but 'didn't complain eleven the entire time' makes no sense, so context immediately disambiguates. Not a persistent trap.

items.context: they pay respect to their ancestors
items.reason: English 'respect' (esteem) maps to Spanish 'respeto' (esteem), which is the same meaning. The false friend 'respecto' (regarding) is a different word. No confusion in this context.
